main.description: Returns repost (share) and star counts for a batch of article URLs in a single call, computed from all tracked repos. Designed for enriching a page of entries with one relay round-trip instead of one per entry. URLs with no observations are omitted from the response (treat a missing key as zero).

article_urls.description: Article URLs to query. At most 500 per call.

counts.description: Map of article URL to its counts. Keys with no share or star observations are omitted.

share_count.description: Number of unique DIDs with a share record for this article URL.

star_count.description: Number of unique DIDs with a star record for this article URL.
